manifesto.body: For thirty years, HUB Surface Systems has connected Canadian communities with pavement technologies that do more than carry traffic. Decorative crosswalks. Civic plazas. Indigenous recognition art. Transit lanes. Parks. Driveways. Surfaces that carry meaning.

why_hub.subtitle: Specified by engineers. Loved by communities.
proof: Stress-tested for de-icing salts, snowplow blades, and the cycles that destroy paint.
Thermoplastic and MMA last 6 to 8 times longer than paint — with no annual repaint window.
Retroreflective crosswalks. High-contrast colour. Slip-resistant by design.
Trusted by transportation engineers, urban designers, and municipal procurement from Vancouver to Halifax.

products.name: TrafficPatternsXD
products.tagline: When the surface has to hold.
products.title: Heavy-duty thermoplastic.
products.italic: 150-mil aggregate-reinforced. Built for BRT corridors and high-volume intersections.
products.body: When bus wheels turn 30,000 times a day through the same intersection, the pavement marking has one job: hold. TrafficPatternsXD is HUB's most durable thermoplastic — 150 mil of aggregate-reinforced material with BPN 65+ certified skid resistance. Specified by Canadian transit authorities and municipalities who need infrastructure that performs as hard as the routes it serves.

products.name: TrafficPatterns
products.tagline: Outlasts paint by seasons, not months.
products.title: Standard thermoplastic.
products.callout_unit: Preformed thermoplastic with Type III glass beads
products.body: Paint crews come back every spring. TrafficPatterns doesn't ask them to. Factory-manufactured preformed thermoplastic that heat-fuses permanently to asphalt and concrete, eliminating the repainting cycle that drains municipal maintenance budgets year after year. Open to traffic in hours. Specified by municipalities from Halifax to Vancouver.

products.name: StreetBond
products.tagline: Coloured pavement that moves with asphalt.
products.title: The colour system.
products.italic: Flexible acrylic. Bonds at the molecular level. Will not peel.
products.callout_unit: Full custom matching, plus extensive standard palette
products.body: Most coloured pavement coatings look vivid in the brochure and embarrassing by the third winter. StreetBond is different — flexible acrylic engineered to move with the asphalt beneath it. Bike lanes, bus priority zones, decorative plazas, and branded driveways. BC Ministry of Transportation recognized.

products.name: StreetPrint
products.tagline: Stamped asphalt at a fraction of stone's lifecycle cost.
products.title: Stamped asphalt.
products.callout_unit: Standard patterns; custom available for landmark projects
products.body: Cobblestone entry courts. Brick-pattern pedestrian plazas. Heritage-look intersections that make drivers slow down without a speed bump in sight. HUB's proprietary in-place asphalt stamping system works with the surface already there. No demolition. No raised edges. The civic richness of natural stone without the lifecycle cost.

products.name: DecoMark
products.title: Custom graphics.
products.italic: Pride crosswalks. Indigenous art. Civic landmarks at street scale.
products.callout_unit: Vector artwork to Pantone-accurate pavement graphics
products.body: A crosswalk is a canvas. DecoMark is how you paint it permanently. Precision preformed thermoplastic, fabricated to your vector artwork and Pantone colour, heat-fused to the road. Pride crosswalks. Indigenous cultural recognition art. Neighbourhood identity installations. Mural-scale public art that lets the street tell a community's story.

products.name: MMAX
products.tagline: Traffic-ready in 30 minutes. Even at -10 C.
products.title: MMA resin lane coating.
products.italic: Methyl methacrylate. Bond strength above 3 MPa. Cures cold.
products.callout_unit: Cure time — traffic-ready before the overnight window closes
products.body: Transit agencies can't shut down a bus lane for a full day while a coating cures. MMAX is built around that reality. Bond strength exceeds 3 MPa, application down to -10 C. The go-to specification for coloured bus lanes, protected bike lanes, and transit priority zones where painted alternatives have already failed.

products.name: StreetBondSR
products.title: Cool surface coating.
products.italic: High SRI. Reduces urban heat island. LEED v4 sustainable sites.
products.callout_unit: Contributes to v4 Sustainable Sites credit for heat island reduction
products.body: Dark pavement absorbs up to 95 percent of solar radiation, contributing measurably to urban heat island. StreetBondSR reflects significantly more solar energy, reducing surface temperatures and contributing to LEED v4 credits. The specification for sustainability-conscious developers and municipalities pursuing climate action plans.

products.name: DuraTherm
products.title: Inlaid thermoplastic.
products.italic: Set into the pavement, not on top of it. Zero profile above grade.
products.callout_unit: Full-depth integration with the asphalt matrix
products.body: Every raised pavement marking is a liability when the snowplow comes through. DuraTherm eliminates the problem entirely — embedded into the asphalt at road level, with zero profile above grade. No shear edge. No trip hazard. No seasonal damage from winter maintenance equipment.

products.name: DuraShield
products.tagline: Maintain a surface, do not replace it.
products.title: Pavement rejuvenator.
products.callout_unit: Penetration depth, replenishing the maltene fraction
products.body: Asphalt oxidizes. The oils that give it flexibility migrate, leaving a brittle surface. DuraShield reverses this — penetrating 6 to 12 mm into the surface, replenishing the maltene fraction, and sealing against water infiltration. The rational choice for teams that would rather maintain than replace.

products.name: PreMark
products.title: Road marking symbols.
products.italic: Turn arrows. Stop bars. Bike pictographs. No stencils required.
products.callout_unit: Standard / heavy-use thicknesses with premium glass bead
products.body: Painted road symbols need stencils, dry time, and a crew back on site every season. PreMark needs none of that. A complete library of preformed thermoplastic symbols — pre-cut to specification and ready to apply with heat. Open to traffic immediately. Premium glass bead retroreflectivity holds nighttime visibility season after season.

products.name: AirMark
products.title: Airfield thermoplastic.
products.italic: Preformed. Heat-applied. Engineered to airfield marking standards.
products.callout_unit: Service life vs. painted alternatives — full-depth glass bead
products.body: Airfield markings are safety-critical. Precision, visibility, and permanence are not negotiable. AirMark preformed thermoplastic is engineered to airfield marking standards, delivering consistent dimensional accuracy, premium retroreflectivity through full-depth glass bead construction, and a service life that outlasts paint by four to one. Heat-applied by certified crews to asphalt and concrete airfield surfaces. The choice for airports and aerodrome operators who need markings that hold their specification year-round.

applications.name: Crosswalks
applications.body: A crosswalk does two jobs: protect pedestrians, and tell a driver someone is about to cross. Paint does both poorly. HUB thermoplastic systems hold ASTM-rated retroreflectivity through snowplow cycles, de-icing seasons, and freeze-thaw.

applications.name: Bike Lanes
applications.tagline: Visibility that holds, season after season.
applications.body: A faded bike lane is a dangerous bike lane. StreetBond UV-stable acrylic and MMAX MMA resin maintain vivid colour through years of traffic and weather without chalking or fading. Bond strength above 3 MPa for cured MMAX zones.

applications.name: Bus Lanes
applications.tagline: Engineered for the harshest urban loads.
applications.body: BRT corridors are among the most demanding surfaces in any city's network. MMAX cures in 30 to 60 minutes, enabling overnight installation. TrafficPatternsXD delivers BPN 65+ skid resistance at bus stops.

applications.name: Parking Lots
applications.tagline: Looks maintained, performs safely, costs less.
applications.body: Parking lots take a disproportionate beating. DuraShield restores oxidized asphalt and seals against deterioration. TrafficPatterns and PreMark thermoplastic stall markings hold retroreflectivity. StreetBond colour treatments create branded wayfinding zones.

applications.name: Parks & Paths
applications.body: The path through a park sets the tone for the whole space. StreetBond applies vivid UV-stable colour to existing surfaces. DecoMark brings mural-quality custom graphics. StreetPrint gives plazas the visual richness of stone.

applications.name: Playgrounds
applications.tagline: Vibrant, slip-resistant, built for hard use.
applications.body: Children are hard on surfaces. DecoMark thermoplastic brings hopscotch courts, number grids, compass roses, and mural-scale artwork to play surfaces with Pantone-accurate colour and flush-surface edges that eliminate trip hazards.

applications.name: Community Branding
applications.tagline: Neighbourhood identity, embedded in the street.
applications.body: Every neighbourhood has a story. Most go untold on the street. DecoMark embeds Pantone-accurate custom graphics directly into asphalt: First Nations cultural artwork, BIA wayfinding, neighbourhood crests, Pride declarations, heritage commemorations.

applications.name: Private Driveways
applications.body: StreetPrint offers in-place stamped asphalt that works with the driveway already there, impressing cobblestone, brick, herringbone, or slate patterns directly into the surface, then sealing it with StreetBond colour.

applications.name: Sport Courts
applications.tagline: Court colour and lines that hold their geometry.
applications.body: Sport courts are one of the most demanding colour environments in outdoor pavement. StreetBond bonds permanently to asphalt and acid-etched concrete, delivering vivid colours and crisp line markings that hold through hard play.

applications.name: Splash Pads
applications.tagline: Slip-resistant. Cool to touch. Vivid colour.
applications.body: Splash pad surfaces are uniquely demanding: constant water exposure, chemical treatments, bare feet. StreetBond builds a slip-resistant texture meeting wet-surface safety standards while delivering vivid, engaging colour.

applications.name: Public Spaces
applications.tagline: Civic plazas, transit forecourts, university campuses.
applications.body: Public plazas and civic squares are the most visible surfaces in any community. StreetPrint stamped asphalt transforms grey paved plazas into rich hardscape environments. StreetBond defines civic zones. Installed at UBC, BC Children's Hospital, and civic plazas coast to coast.

applications.name: Commercial Spaces
applications.tagline: Premium hardscape. Mixed-use developments and hospitality.
applications.body: Retail centres, mixed-use developments, hotel porte-cocheres. The surface underfoot signals the quality of everything inside. StreetPrint delivers the visual weight of premium stone paving at a fraction of full installation cost.

applications.name: Townhomes
applications.body: Townhome and strata developments live and die by their first impression. StreetPrint stamped asphalt driveways and entry courts deliver the look of clay pavers or stone cobble at a fraction of the cost — no settling, no weeding.

applications.name: Pedestrian Safety
applications.body: Pedestrian safety isn't aesthetic aspiration — it's a measurable outcome. Retroreflective thermoplastic. High-contrast colour that persists through de-icing salt cycles. The complete specification for engineers taking Vision Zero seriously.

applications.name: Traffic Calming
applications.body: Colour changes driver behaviour. Gateway treatments, speed table surface markings, and intersection colour reduce vehicle entry speeds without requiring physical barriers that impede emergency response.

applications.name: LEED & Heat Island
applications.body: Standard dark asphalt absorbs the vast majority of solar radiation. StreetBondSR reduces surface temperatures and contributes to LEED v4 Sustainable Sites credit. The specification for sustainable development and climate action plans.

applications.name: Public Art
applications.body: The street is one of the largest untapped canvases in any city. HUB public art installations turn that canvas into permanent, weather-resistant community expression. From BC Children's Hospital labyrinth to UBC Indigenous cultural crosswalks.

projects.name: York Region VIVA BRT
projects.title: BRT corridor, open in 90 minutes.
projects.story: MMAX red MMA resin bus lane markings for York Region's VIVA Rapid Transit corridor — one of Canada's highest-ridership BRT networks. Bond strength above 3 MPa. Applied overnight. Open to full bus traffic in 90 minutes. No daytime closure. No paint cycle. The specification that defines bus priority.

projects.name: Toronto Priority Bus Lanes
projects.title: Twelve corridors. One transit network.
projects.story: MMAX red resin treatments across 12 priority bus corridors in Toronto — one of the largest single-contract MMA deployments in Canada. One overnight cure window per corridor. No daytime closures. No repaint cycle. The specification TTC engineers reach for when painted alternatives have already failed.

projects.name: BC Children's Hospital
projects.title: Playful surfaces. Healing spaces.
projects.story: StreetBond coatings and DecoMark surface graphics — including a meditation labyrinth — installed across active wards and ground-level plazas at BC Children's Hospital. Designed with Connect Landscape Architecture. The surfaces are slip-resistant, chemical-resistant, and built to perform in a healthcare environment.

projects.name: New Westminster Complete Streets
projects.title: Modal clarity, written in colour.
projects.story: Complete Streets across New Westminster: StreetBond green for protected bike lanes, TrafficPatterns retroreflective crosswalks, high-contrast colour at every conflict point. Modal priority made legible. Cyclists protected. Pedestrians seen. The Complete Streets specification that transportation engineers and urban planners return to.

projects.name: UBC Musqueam Crosswalk
projects.title: A surface is also a statement.
projects.story: A collaboration with UBC and the Musqueam Nation. Coast Salish art patterns stamped into asphalt at the centre of campus — an institutional acknowledgement made permanent, at street scale, in a material that will outlast the generation that commissioned it.

projects.name: Terry Fox Plaza
projects.title: A plaza that earns its name.
projects.story: StreetPrint stamped asphalt and StreetBond colour at Terry Fox Plaza — a civic landmark in the heart of Coquitlam. The surface underfoot reads as premium stone. It performs as pavement. In twenty years, it will still look like it belongs.

projects.name: Spirit Trail
projects.title: Seven kilometres of intent.
projects.story: StreetBond colour treatment along the Spirit Trail — North Shore's signature waterfront active transportation corridor. Consistent colour identity over seven kilometres of shared pathway guiding cyclists and pedestrians along one of Canada's most scenic urban routes.

projects.name: White Rock Pier
projects.title: Salt air. Holiday traffic. Held.
projects.story: Salt spray. Summer surge. Winter rain. The pier crosswalk at White Rock faces the full force of the BC coast — and holds season after season. TrafficPatternsXD installed where paint would be gone by July.

projects.name: Tsain-Ko Crosswalk
projects.title: Knowledge keeper, street level.
projects.story: The Tsain-Ko crosswalk honours the shíshálh Nation in permanent DecoMark thermoplastic at the heart of Sechelt. Cultural knowledge translated to pavement by community artists — a living acknowledgement walked over daily, visible through every season, built to outlast the generation that commissioned it.

projects.name: Every Child Matters
projects.title: Honouring residential schools survivors.
projects.story: Town of Georgina honours the Every Child Matters movement with a permanent TrafficPatterns thermoplastic crosswalk. A civic acknowledgement cast in durable material — walked over every day, visible every season.

projects.name: Simcoe Rainbow Crosswalk
projects.title: Two years of fundraising. One street.
projects.story: A young Simcoe resident's two-year fundraising campaign, realized in TrafficPatternsXD by Multiseal. A rainbow crosswalk that holds colour and retroreflectivity season after season — long after painted alternatives would have faded from memory.

projects.name: Bowen Island Path
projects.title: Forest. Sunset. Water. Earth.
projects.story: A community art path at Snug Cove, Bowen Island. Custom StreetBond in four colours — forest, sunset, water, and earth — community identity built permanently into the surface of the path that connects the village to the waterfront.

projects.name: Murrayville Schoolhouse
projects.title: A schoolhouse, a sidewalk, a memory.
projects.story: StreetPrint stamped-asphalt sidewalk linking the historic Murrayville Schoolhouse to the community around it. Heritage-look surface for a heritage building — brick-pattern asphalt that reads as stone and performs as pavement.

projects.name: Parc Riviera
projects.title: Where a path becomes a place.
projects.story: StreetBond colour treatment on the main pedestrian walkway at Parc Riviera — a residential development in Laval where the surface investment signals quality from the first step. Distinctive colour that turns a circulation path into an amenity residents actively choose to use.

installers.name: Square One Paving
installers.body: Experts in asphalt imprinting across British Columbia. Outstanding products, best-in-class installation for municipalities, developers, and contractors.

installers.name: Thermo Design
installers.body: Specialiste en marquage de longue duree. Long-life decorative pavement markings for Quebec municipalities and commercial sites.

installers.name: Virtue Construction
installers.body: Quality project outcomes since 2009. Decorative paving services for Saskatchewan communities, certified to install the full HUB Surface Systems portfolio.

installers.name: ULS Landscaping
installers.body: 10+ years of trusted experience. Professional landscape management with certified decorative paving installation across Alberta and Saskatchewan.
